card.name: Inside split-up drug and rare words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a long word that the text splits apart, mostly drug names like fenofibrates, moexipril, tranylcypromine and troleandomycin. It also fires on endings in rarer words like impishly and showiest.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, before the rest of the name follows.

modes.label: Rare ordinary words
modes.description: A middle or ending piece of an uncommon general-English word.
